questions.text:
Choose the most appropriate option.
(i) Which of the following is a binomial: (a) 2x × y (b) 3x²y + 4xy² (c) 3a ÷ 2b (d) 8x²y + 16x²y
(ii) The value of (243)^(3/5) is : (a) 81 (b) 9 (c) 27 (d) 18
(iii) The perimeter of a semicircle, whose radius is 9.1 cm is : (a) 50.2 cm (b) 28.6 cm (c) 46.8 cm (d) 25.1 cm
(iv) In which quadrant does (-3, -4) lie ? (a) First (b) Second (c) Third (d) Fourth
(v) Which of the following geometrical figures has exactly two lines of symmetry ? (a) Square (b) rectangle (c) Parallelogram (d) Isosceles trapezium
(vi) In which of the following solids, none of the faces is triangular ? (a) Triangular Prism (b) Square Pyramid (c) Pentagonal prism (d) Hexagonal Prism
(vii) If x + y = 6 and xy = 10, the value of (x² + y²) is : (a) 16 (b) 10 (c) 26 (d) 36
(viii) 72 men do a piece of work in 25 days. In how many days will 30 men do the same work ? (a) 45 days (b) 60 days (c) 38 days (d) 70 days
(ix) In how many years will ₹ 950 produce ₹ 399 as Simple interest at 7% ? (a) 6 years (b) 8 years (c) 4 years (d) 7 years
(x) √72 × √98 =? (a) 42 (b) 74 (c) 64 (d) 84
(xi) If 3^(x−1) + 3^(x+1) = 90, then x is equal to : (a) 0 (b) 1 (c) 2 (d) 3
(xii) Distance of a point from x-axis is called : (a) Abscissa (b) Ordinate (c) Co-ordinate (d) None of these
(xiii) A park is 8 metre long and 6 meter broad. The length of the longest pole that can be placed in the park is : (a) 12m (b) 10m (c) 8m (d) 11m
(xiv) Euler's formula is : (a) F + E + V = 2 (b) F – E + V = 2 (c) F – E – V = 2 (d) F + E – V = 2
(xv) In what time will a sum of money double itself at 6 ¼% p.a. simple interest ? (a) 5 years (b) 12 years (c) 8 years (d) 16 years
